question: A vendor buys 42 laptop bags for ₹41,622 and sells them at 35 for ₹37,345. How many laptop bags should be bought and sold to earn a profit of ₹3,952?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of 1 bag = 41,622 ÷ 42 = ₹991.

Selling Price (SP) of 1 bag = 37,345 ÷ 35 = ₹1,067.

Profit per bag = SP − CP = 1,067 − 991 = ₹76.

Number of bags required for total profit = Total Profit ÷ Profit per bag.

Number of bags = 3,952 ÷ 76 = 52.

**∴ The correct answer is 52 laptop bags.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total CP of 42 bags = ₹41,622 | Total SP of 35 bags = ₹37,345 | Target Profit = ₹3,952.

**Formulas:** CP per unit = Total CP ÷ Quantity | SP per unit = Total SP ÷ Quantity | Profit per unit = SP − CP | Required Quantity = Total Profit ÷ Profit per unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7261eae0fe3453354c218b5b941f923de229462ac747098c556110ae16497424.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Calculate CP of one bag = 41,622 ÷ 42 = **₹991**.

⇒ Step 2: Calculate SP of one bag = 37,345 ÷ 35 = **₹1,067**.

⇒ Step 3: Calculate Profit per bag = 1,067 − 991 = **₹76**.

⇒ Step 4: Calculate Number of bags = 3,952 ÷ 76 = **52**.

**∴ The correct answer is 52 laptop bags.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method in Profit and Loss

When buying and selling quantities are different, always find the **Cost Price** and **Selling Price** for a single unit (1 item) to simplify calculations.

Profit Percentage Calculation

Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100. In this case, Profit% = (76 ÷ 991) × 100 ≈ **7.67%**.
